question.content: I want to verify my details, my Aadhaar number is 987654321012 and my mobile number is 9876543210

function.name: pmkisan_verify_farmer
function.description: Verifies the identity of a farmer using Aadhaar number and registered mobile number through OTP authentication. This establishes user identity for accessing personalized PM-KISAN services. Prerequisites: None. This tool must be called before tools that require authenticated access such as checking eKYC status, payment status, updating details, or raising helpdesk tickets. It does NOT perform eKYC, retrieve payment/installment data, check registration status, or update any beneficiary information.

mobile_number.description: Mobile number linked with Aadhaar for OTP-based verification

question.content: Can you check my eKYC status, my Aadhaar number is 123456789012

function.name: pmkisan_check_ekyc_status
function.description: Retrieves the current eKYC status (completed or pending) of the farmer under PM-KISAN. Prerequisites: pmkisan_verify_farmer must be successfully completed to ensure authenticated access. It does NOT perform or update eKYC, generate OTP, or retrieve payment or registration details.

question.content: I want to complete my eKYC, my Aadhaar number is 234567890123 and the OTP is 456789

function.name: pmkisan_complete_ekyc
function.description: Completes the Aadhaar-based eKYC process for a farmer using OTP verification. This updates the farmer's compliance status required for receiving benefits. Prerequisites: pmkisan_verify_farmer must be completed prior to this step. It does NOT check eKYC status, retrieve payments, or update other beneficiary details.

otp.description: One-time password sent to Aadhaar-linked mobile number

question.content: Please tell me my PM Kisan payment status, my Aadhaar number is 345678901234

function.name: pmkisan_get_payment_status
function.description: Fetches the PM-KISAN installment/payment status for the authenticated farmer, including whether installments are credited or pending. Prerequisites: pmkisan_verify_farmer must be completed before calling this tool. It does NOT modify payment records, perform eKYC, or update beneficiary information.

question.content: I want to know my registration status, my Aadhaar number is 456789012345

function.name: pmkisan_check_registration_status
function.description: Checks the status of a farmer's self-registration in the PM-KISAN scheme (e.g., approved, pending, rejected). Prerequisites: pmkisan_verify_farmer must be completed to access the registration status. It does NOT submit a new registration, update existing records, or fetch payment details.

question.content: I want to register for PM Kisan, my Aadhaar number is 567890123456, my name is Ramesh Kumar, my bank account number is 12345678901234, IFSC code is SBIN0001234 and my mobile number is 9123456789

function.name: pmkisan_submit_self_registration
function.description: Submits a new self-registration request for enrolling a farmer into the PM-KISAN scheme using Aadhaar and bank details. Prerequisites: None, but valid Aadhaar, bank, and personal details must be provided. It does NOT verify identity automatically, check registration status, or update existing beneficiary records.

farmer_name.description: Full name of the farmer as per Aadhaar records

bank_account_number.description: Bank account number for receiving PM-KISAN benefits

ifsc_code.description: IFSC code of the farmer's bank branch

question.content: I want to update my mobile number in PM Kisan, my Aadhaar number is 678901234567 and new mobile number is 9988776655

function.name: pmkisan_update_beneficiary_details
function.description: Updates existing beneficiary details such as mobile number or bank account information for a registered farmer. Prerequisites: pmkisan_verify_farmer must be completed before making updates. It does NOT register a new farmer, check payment status, or perform eKYC.

new_value.description: New value corresponding to the selected field

question.content: I have not received my payment, my Aadhaar number is 789012345678, please raise a complaint saying payment not received

function.name: pmkisan_raise_helpdesk_ticket
function.description: Creates a helpdesk support ticket for issues related to PM-KISAN such as payment failure, registration problems, or eKYC issues. Prerequisites: pmkisan_verify_farmer should be completed to associate the issue with a verified farmer. It does NOT track ticket progress or resolve the issue; it only registers the complaint.

issue_category.description: Category of the issue being reported

description.description: Detailed explanation of the issue faced by the farmer

question.content: I want to check my complaint status, my ticket id is TICKET12345

function.name: pmkisan_track_ticket_status
function.description: Retrieves the current status of a previously raised PM-KISAN helpdesk ticket using its ticket ID. Prerequisites: pmkisan_raise_helpdesk_ticket must have been called earlier to generate a valid ticket ID. It does NOT create new tickets, modify tickets, or resolve complaints.

ticket_id.description: Unique identifier of the helpdesk ticket

question.content: I want to surrender my PM Kisan benefits, my Aadhaar number is 890123456789 and I confirm yes

function.name: pmkisan_surrender_benefits
function.description: Allows a farmer to voluntarily surrender their PM-KISAN benefits if they are no longer eligible or wish to opt out. Prerequisites: pmkisan_verify_farmer must be completed to confirm identity. It does NOT check eligibility, retrieve payment history, or allow reversal once processed.

confirmation.description: Explicit confirmation from the farmer to proceed with surrender
